label: About
title: About Where the Patch Weeps Down
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 7 recent saved-signal files and 4 captured links, then narrowed the page to 1 source windows around @gucci4mycat: Dugucci spooky collection out in 5 days on @vvvdotso Free for prev collections.... A source image from pbs.twimg.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became Where the Patch Weeps Down: Shadowless scan of one wet-dyed sheet on flat sage green, landscape. Left of center, three dye-blot heads huddle: orange pumpkin, cream skull-ghost with teal eye-sockets, magenta tomato, each with green star calyx and dark eye band. After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 1 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against huddled dye-blot head cluster with calyx crowns, lavender-violet drip curtain under the heads, and purple pooled band at the bottom edge.
